mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER m JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_TYPE = 'LAWYER' AND m.STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' AND l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CASE WHERE STEP = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 4 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') ORDER BY "date" ASC
SELECT TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TB_CASE WHERE CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 4 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') ORDER BY "date" ASC

SELECT r.REPORT_ID as "reportId", r.REPORTER_ID as "reporterId", m.NAME as "reporterName", r.TARGET_ID as "targetId", r.TARGET_TYPE as "targetType", r.REASON as "reason", r.STATUS as "status", TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "createdAt" FROM TB_REPORT r LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON r.REPORTER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REPORT_ID as "reportId", r.REPORTER_ID as "reporterId", m.NAME as "reporterName", r.TARGET_ID as "targetId", r.TARGET_TYPE as "targetType", r.REASON as "reason", r.DETAIL as "detail", r.STATUS as "status", r.RESULT_NOTE as "resultNote", TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "createdAt" FROM TB_REPORT r LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON r.REPORTER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}

SELECT p.PAYMENT_ID as "paymentId", p.CONSULT_ID as "consultId", p.PAYER_ID as "memberId", m.NAME as "memberName", p.AMOUNT as "amount", p.PAY_METHOD as "method", p.PAY_STATUS as "status", TO_CHAR(p.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "createdAt" FROM TB_PAYMENT p LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON p.PAYER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.SETTLE_ID as "settlementId", s.LAWYER_ID as "lawyerId", m.NAME as "lawyerName", s.GROSS_AMT as "grossAmt", s.COMMISSION_RATE as "commissionRate", s.COMMISSION_AMT as "commissionAmt", s.NET_AMT as "netAmount", s.SETTLE_STATUS as "status", TO_CHAR(s.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "createdAt" FROM TB_SETTLEMENT s LEFT JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON s.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC
